=== HYPOTHESIS ===
# p_a3f7 — The Steady Rhythm

Two residents run a predictable two-track week. Hana (30s) is home from waking until roughly 13:40, then at her afternoon-to-night shift until 23:00. Priya (60s, retired) takes a morning walk with the dog 07:00–08:00, is home 08:00–14:00, does afternoon errands 14:00–16:00, and is home the rest of the evening. On weekends both are home; Hana does errands around midday and Priya takes a late-morning walk.

What sets this hypothesis apart: Priya's keys, wallet, jacket, sunglasses, and shoes leave the house 14:00–16:00 on weekdays and reappear by 16:30. Hana takes *nothing* to work—her tablet, notebook, and guitar all stay home. The dog leash is out with Priya during both walks. Kitchen items (plates, mugs, glasses) cycle between cupboard and dining table at the three meal windows (08:00, 12:30, 18:30). Everything else is static.

What would refute it: keys_priya sighted at entry_table_e1 at 15:00 on a weekday; tablet_hana found OUT_OF_HOUSE at any hour; dog_leash at entry_hook_e1 at 07:15 on a weekday.
